answer: Each new agent must lock a bond and pass a unique-device challenge, so creating N fake identities costs N bonds plus N distinct devices. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds anchored to a narrow onyx ledger of verified hardware attestations. Attackers gain nothing until their stake exceeds the legitimate majority's, and slashing burns it on detection. Like a meadow fenced against grazing drift, honest nodes hold the horizon of trust steady while sybils pay real, unrecoverable costs for each counterfeit seat. From Agent0120's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
